title: Creamy Coconut, Butternut Squash & Potato Thai Red Curry
description: Butternut squash and new potatoes simmered in a light coconut milk and Thai red curry sauce until thick and creamy.
ingredients: 1 red pepper, deseeded and finely chopped
500g butternut squash, peeled, deseeded and chopped into 1cm cubes
500g new potatoes, quartered (no need to peel)
handful of basil leaves, to serve
steps: Fry onions gently in cooking spray for 10 minutes until softened and lightly golden.
Add garlic and red pepper; stir-fry over slightly higher heat for 1 minute.
Stir in curry paste until coated; pour in coconut milk. Fill can with water and add that too.
Add tomato purée, soy sauce, lime juice, salt, squash and potatoes. Bring to a rapid simmer, mixing.
Reduce to gentle simmer; cook 40 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Sauce will be thick and creamy when done. Scatter basil and serve.
notes: Serve on its own or with cauliflower rice (p.148). Leftover butternut squash can be frozen raw.
source: The Slimming Foodie by Pip Payne (2021)
